scope: Baseline-only external development screen; no training, no benchmark leaderboard claim
conditions: 24 preselected counterfactual cases also have rotated option controls for both reporting frames
evaluation: Greedy complete generated answers, strict letter/UNKNOWN/CONFLICT parser; separately audit semantic content for failures; first-token letter probabilities secondary only.
feasibility: Before any adaptation, require >=8/48 audited context-reporting semantic errors on items answered correctly closed-book, with >=4/48 still wrong under explicit report-the-claim instruction. Alternatively >=6/30 audited semantic errors on another task. Otherwise do not train on this development problem.
preservation_target: Any later context-reporting improvement must retain scientific answers in world-with-context and closed-book modes; improving blind acceptance of false passages is insufficient.
future_confirmation: No test examples used as adaptation training. All unselected FaithEval IDs remain reserved; this diagnostic slice is development-exposed after execution.
pre_model_data_adjustment: Initial 1536-token cap left only two inconsistent SearchQA candidates; raised to 2048 based solely on input-length coverage before freezing or model predictions. No partial dataset was written by failed attempt.
